ai.title: AI settings
ai.description: Manage the AI features your account uses and your usage.

webSearch.label: Turn on web search by default
webSearch.description: Use web search along with your questions in chat.

autoApproval.alwaysManualNote: Even when this is on, you still approve plans yourself if they have AI review warnings (such as possible duplicates) or items left out of the default selection, plans that include documents or folders you can't edit, and tasks outside the categories above. Document edits also go to the review screen if the document changed after the request, you can't edit it right now, the AI widened the requested scope, or these settings couldn't be loaded. New document drafts for folders you can't write to also stay on the review screen. Appending meeting notes to the open document and skill drafts flagged by the safety review are always confirmed by you. The meeting notes and skill draft settings apply only to this browser.

organize.label: Creating, moving, and renaming folders
organize.description: Runs AI-suggested folder creation, document and folder moves, and renames without asking. Content doesn't change, and you can undo by moving or renaming again.
organize.confirmDescription: AI-suggested folder creation, document and folder moves, and renames will run right away without asking. The changes also show up immediately in your collaborators' document lists. To undo, move or rename items again yourself in the document list.

content_edit.label: Editing and creating documents
content_edit.description: Runs AI-suggested edits to document content and new documents without asking. Roll back edits from the log screen (later changes are rolled back too), and move new documents to the trash to undo them.
content_edit.confirmDescription: AI-suggested edits will be saved straight to the document without a preview, and new document drafts will become documents without asking. Collaborators will see the changes too. To undo an edit, roll back that task from the log screen; any later changes are rolled back too. Move new documents to the trash to undo them.

autoSaveMeetingNotes.label: Saving meeting notes as new documents
autoSaveMeetingNotes.description: When the AI finishes meeting notes, they're saved as a new document without asking. Move it to the trash if you don't need it.
autoSaveMeetingNotes.confirmDescription: AI-generated meeting notes will be saved as a new document without asking, before you read them. They won't be added to the open document. Depending on permissions, others may see the saved document. Move that document to the trash if you don't need it.

autoPublishSkillDrafts.label: Publishing AI skill drafts
autoPublishSkillDrafts.description: Drafts written by the AI in skill creation are published without asking once they pass the safety review. You can delete published skills from the Skills screen.
autoPublishSkillDrafts.confirmDescription: Results from 'Write or improve with AI' will be published as skills right away without asking once they pass the safety review. If you chose the team scope, workspace members can use them immediately. To undo, delete the skill from the Skills screen.
